name: Bettina Rothe
reason: Her own site (bettinarothe.com, read 4 Nov 2026) presents her as an embodied leadership coach and 5Rhythms dance teacher whose workshops and retreats include some programmes with 'carefully chosen plant medicines', and she works as a psychedelic preparation and integration guide through Nectara; with plant-medicine retreats and psychedelic guiding sold alongside leadership coaching, she falls under the sprint's skip for psychedelic-therapy and leadership-led work (her Hollyhock 'Dance of Connection' retreat, 18-23 June 2027, is itself clean).
